Open Bench: Remote Repair Lab — registration policy

Registration is open from 2027-02-12T17:30:00.000Z inclusive until 2027-02-20T02:15:00.000Z exclusive. Compare the submittedAt timestamp exactly at UTC millisecond precision; a submission at the closing instant is late.

Applicants must be at least 16. Applicants aged 18 or older need no guardian consent. Applicants aged 16 or 17 need guardian consent unless they are BOTH a resident AND a member. Those two statuses together waive consent. Student and scholarship status do not change admission. Every applicant must satisfy both the registration window and the age/consent rule.

Charge a fee only when admitted. Denied applicants have no fee (null). For admitted applicants, use the FIRST matching line in this ordered USD fee list:
1. Scholarship: $0.00 (0 cents).
2. Resident AND member: $18.50 (1850 cents).
3. Student AND member: $26.50 (2650 cents).
4. Resident: $34.50 (3450 cents).
5. Student: $45.50 (4550 cents).
6. Member: $49.50 (4950 cents).
7. Otherwise: $63.50 (6350 cents).

The five status flags—resident, student, member, guardianConsent, and scholarship—are independent booleans. No status implies another.
